title: My AI turned one sentence into an essay
description:
Skill files are always bloated out of proportion. Here is what that actually looks like.

The whole instruction was: here is your scratchpad, here is the mail, report to the user in short. That's it, that's the entire skill.

Instead it started with "you arrive with no memory, and the solution to that is the scratchpad. Read the scratchpad before..." and kept going. It writes like it is instructing a model smaller than Haiku.

But even then, instructions in the 4chan greentext style are enough.

Full breakdown: https://youtube.com/watch?v=9u_5zsQjeqI

#ai #claude #codex #valo #prompting #shorts
